metadata.title: linear sync threw plain Error (no exitCode) → runtime double-invocation
metadata.description: linear sync (and the linear-sync importer) threw plain Error on missing team/key and API errors; pm re-invokes the handler on the unhandled path. Added CommandError mirroring SDK EXIT_CODE; the sync catch now preserves a specific exitCode (missing key=2) instead of flattening to generic. missing-team/key=2, API-failure=1; single invocation.

metadata.close_reason: Fixed: CommandError carries exitCode. Verified missing-team/key exit 2 (USAGE preserved), API failure exits 1, single invocation; 2 tests pass.

metadata.author: codex

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.
metadata.author: codex
